case_number: 2025 INSC 362; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. @ SLP(CRL) NOS.13258-13259/2024

parties.petitioner: Shri Khereshwar Mahadev Va Dauji Maharaj Samiti, Aligarh
parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.

summary: Temple management dispute; civil suit pending; High Court directed compliance with 2007 SDM order; failure to consider appellate civil court order and SDM report; writ petition maintainability; Gram Sabha resolution requirement under Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, 1947; PIL in private lis; status quo to continue; impugned orders set aside; civil suit to be decided within six months; Gram Sabha to be impleaded.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, 1947 s.34, s.35
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned orders set aside; status quo continued; civil suit to be decided within six months; Gram Sabha to be impleaded.
